title: M5 stage43: actual arithmetic birth and all-order exceptions
scope: Actual C/A integration; no supplied oracle correctness or physical witness premises. Recovery remains a separate original obligation.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.order_count_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → (0 < M5.OrderCount.C N w F ↔ (∃ S U : Finset ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U))
spec.guidance: Split on F dividing cyclicModulus N. In the dividing case use27 C_positive_iff_realization and convert range subsets to element bounds in realizes. In the other case C=0; a physical realization would force F dividing cyclicModulus via gcd_dvd_right. Do not assume period divisibility in the target. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.order_count_nonnegative
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 ≤ M5.OrderCount.C N w F
spec.guidance: Split on divisibility and use27 C_nonnegative or the cutoff C=0. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.order_exception
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → (M5.OrderCount.C N w F = 0 ↔ ¬ (∃ S U : Finset ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U))
spec.guidance: Use integer nonnegativity and the positive iff theorem. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.birth_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 2 ≤ w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.ResidueCount.A w F → ∃ b : ℕ, M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.birth w F = some b ∧ (∃ S U : Finset ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes b w F S U) ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, (∃ S U : Finset ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U) → b ≤ N
spec.guidance: Apply38 birth_exact. Necessary bounds30 give max(w,degF+1)≤N and period divides N. This lower bound implies N>0. Use actual order_count_iff, and obtain bounded physical witness at j=0 from39 positive_bounded_progression. No witness/exactcount oracle is an input premise. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.birth_none
spec.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 2 ≤ w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → (M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.birth w F = none ↔ M5.ResidueCount.A w F = 0)
spec.guidance: Forward: A is nonnegative by39, if positive birth_exact contradicts none. Reverse:39 rules out every physical order; use38 birth_none_iff and order_count_iff on candidate orders, which are positive by the weight lower bound. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.later_exception
spec.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 2 ≤ w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → ∀ b N : ℕ, M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.birth w F = some b → b ≤ N → ((¬ M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N ∨ M5.OrderCount.C N w F = 0) ↔ ¬ (∃ S U : Finset ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U))
spec.guidance: From some birth get candidate membership and b≥w using birth definition. Thus N>0. Use order_exception; necessity30 excludes orders not divisible by the period. This classifies arbitrary later orders, not merely the constructed progression. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.
